Comprehension: Students will demonstrate the ability to understand spoken Spanish as evident in responses through prepared dialogs and presentations as well as impromptu conversations with other students and the professor. Students will also demonstrate understanding of spoken Spanish on graded exams and directed interview questions.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to write using appropriate grammatical forms as well as vocabulary appropriate to the level of those students who are seeking an AA-T degree in Spanish.

Writing: Students will demonstrate the ability to write using appropriate grammatical forms as well as vocabulary appropriate to the level of those students who are seeking an AA-T degree in Spanish. They will show this through informal writing and formal writing.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to exhibit reading comprehension of informal and formal written texts including informal letters or short essays as well as literature and news articles from various parts of the Spanish-speaking world.

Reading: Students will exhibit reading comprehension of informal and formal written texts including informal letters or short essays as well as literature and news articles from various parts of the Spanish speaking world.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to speak using appropriate grammatical forms as well as vocabulary appropriate to the level of those students who are seeking an AA-T degree in Spanish.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will have developed a deeper understanding and appreciation of Hispanic cultures as they create connections between language acquisition and cultural context.

programs.title: Sports Medicine
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, students will be able to distinguish the pathways and requirements for career opportunities within Kinesiology, including Athletic Training.

Upon successful completion of the program, the students will be able to implement an emergency action plan (EAP), including primary and secondary surveys of an injured individual and administration of emergency care procedures.

Upon successful completion of the program, the students will be able to identify blood-borne pathogens, administer basic first aid, and incorporate appropriate splinting and taping techniques for an array of injuries using various medical supplies.

Upon successful completion of the program, students will be able to appraise musculoskeletal imbalances that may predispose athletes to injury, interpret sports-related injury information, and communicate that information to various members of the sports medicine team.
Upon successful completion of the program, students will be able to design and administer basic injury rehabilitation programs.

programs.title: Student Success
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program the student will be able to successfully navigate both on-campus and online resources.

Upon successful completion of the program the student will be able to choose and apply essential tools and strategies necessary to support independent learning to reach their goals of certification, graduation, and/or transfer.

programs.title: Studio Arts
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to investigate a variety of Art styles, techniques and mediums utilizing the elements and principles of design.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to critically analyze the concepts and process of making a work of Art.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will create a series of Artworks that express their ideas through a chosen medium.

programs.title: Study Skills for College Success
outcomes: Upon successful completion of this program, the student will be able to build fluency and comprehension as they relate to textbook reading and vocabulary development.
Upon successful completion of this program, the student will be able to develop and improve note-taking, test-taking, and memory skills and strategies.
Upon successful completion of this program, the student will be able to choose and implement effective time management tools and strategies.

programs.title: Suspension and Steering
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units
outcomes: Demonstrate proficiency in technical skills and safety principles required for employment in the transportation and related industries performing suspension and steering work.
Demonstrate their ability to assess, evaluate and solve problems common to suspension and steering system repair in the automotive, industrial, and agricultural industries.
Demonstrate a thorough understanding of the core suspension and steering system material required for transfer to a four year university or certification in the department programs.

programs.title: Sustainable Landscape
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units
outcomes: Demonstrate managerial and leadership abilities in environmental horticulture classes for employment that will enhance opportunities and success in the horticulture industry in the 21st century
Master academic proficiency and demonstrate specific skills within environmental horticulture disciplines needed for employment.
Master skills needed for baccalaureate level education or obtain a certificate.

Demonstrate the ability to communicate with clients, assess a landscape for ecological and economic sustainability, measure and analyze a property, the soil and cultural conditions and installation methods for landscape productivity, construction and Irrigation.

Evaluate, identify and utilize pertinent concepts of plant physiology, anatomy, nutrition, reproduction, cultural care, and pest control to solve horticultural problems under field, greenhouse or landscape conditions.
Select proper landscape and irrigation materials, tools and machinery and demonstrate their use in landscape industry operations.

programs.title: Teaching and Learning
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply relevant theories and research-based strategies in analyzing data for student retention, progression, and completion, exploring instructional technology, student-centered design, classroom management, and student engagement as they relate to the community college teaching and learning.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to analyze, theories and best practices for teaching and learning.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to integrate current theories, research-based strategies, and best practices for pedagogy and andragogy development.
Upon successful completion of the course, the student will be able to begin to apply leadership theories, strategies, and skills to the college and/or workplace
Upon successful completion of the course, the student will be able to apply effective learning success strategies and skills that support student success.

programs.title: Teaching with AI: Today and Tomorrow
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to leverage the benefits of AI to support student learning and make work more efficient.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to manage the limitations of AI through an understanding of privacy and ethical issues as well as AI-resilient assessment practices.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply an understanding of long-term considerations of AI to guide current implementation strategies.

programs.title: Theatre Arts

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply acquired skills and knowledge, through successful group or individual performance, appropriate to a particular performing art form.

programs.title: Transitional Kindergarten

outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to compose a developmentally appropriate curriculum to foster art, science, math, english literacy, history, engineering, and other subjects related to the transitional kindergarten classroom.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to compile strategies for assisting families and children with challenging behaviors.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to explain the development of children in the cognitive, physical, and social/emotional domains.

programs.title: UCTP Chemistry
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply logical quantitative and qualitative reasoning in solving problems.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply the methodologies of chemistry when approaching a problem.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply physical principles to laboratory research that explains natural chemical phenomena and processes.

programs.title: UCTP Physics
outcomes: At the conclusion of this program, the student should be able to articulate fundamental laws that explain physical phenomena.
At the conclusion of this program, the student should be able to synthesize the methodologies of science and calculus when approaching a physics problem.

At the conclusion of this program, the student should be able to apply logical quantitative and qualitative reasoning in conducting laboratory activities, analyzing physics problems, or constructing explanatory arguments of mechanism.

outcomes: Demonstrate an understanding of how to use and practice basic assessment (data collection), participate in planning, execute interventions in accordance with the care plan or treatment plan, and contribute to evaluation of individualized intervention related to the care plan or treatment plan.

Perform direct patient/client care in which the student a. Performs basic nursing services b. Administers medications c. Applies communication skills for the purpose of patient/client care and education; and d. programs.title: Warehousing

Upon successful completion of the course, the student will be able to exceed customers’ expectations.
Upon successful completion of the course, the student will be able to safely operate a Class V forklift in a competent manner.

programs.title: Web Design and Development

outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to use principles of design to construct and develop quality, intuitive websites that are easy to navigate.

programs.title: Welding
